newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp stock rises on Merrill upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp stock rises on Merrill upgrade.

text.p: Citicorp stock rose 5-7/8 to 130 Tuesday afternoon, after Merrill Lynch analyst Judah Kraushaar upgraded the stock to an intermediate-term buy from accumulate.
The stock, one of the 25 most heavily-traded on the New York Stock Exchange, opened trading Tuesday at 127-1/2.
In his report, issued today, the analyst said that Citicorp may announce a major restructuring program in the third quarter that could boost 1998 earnings by $1 a share.
He currrently estimates earnings of $9.45 per share in full year 1998.
He also projected a year-end stock price objective of at least 168 for Citicorp shares.
The analyst added that worries over Citicorp's Asian earnings and its credit card business appear excessive.

Kraushaar said that the recent downward trend in credit card earnings is nearing a bottom, and that Citicorp has begun to see increasing new business, reflecting a "flight to quality" as people and companies flee troubled Asian financial institutions.
The analyst retained his long-term buy recommendation for Citicorp shares.
